title: CHOOSE YOUR PATH
subtitle: A New Route Every Run
description: Plot your course across a shifting, procedurally generated hex map. Weigh the risks and rewards of every tile as you battle through a dense <u>forest</u>, a forgotten <u>temple</u>, and a <u>ruined</u> wasteland.

title: Adapat and Survive
subtitle: Master Every Playstyle
description: Dive into fast-paced combat against overwhelming enemy numbers. Discover new weapons every time you leave the Haven, allowing you to experiment with unique playstyles and destructive builds on every single run.

title: CHOOSE YOUR Class
subtitle: Master Every Role
description: Define your playstyle by choosing your character’s Class. Each Class completely changes your abilities and how you approach the battlefield on every run.

title: FORGE YOUR BUILD
subtitle: Seek True Mastery
description: Your Class is just the beginning. Push further outward run after run, seeking hidden locations where you can truly master your class.

title: RELENTLESS ENEMIES
subtitle: Face the Robo-Beasts
description: Battle a terrifying mechanical threat. Adapt your strategy to the unique attack patterns of the Robo-Beasts as you hold the line against overwhelming swarms and towering, screen-filling bosses.
